suggestion.title: New jutsu icon
suggestion.rationale: New icon from the director-approved player jutsu overhaul.

New icon: a whirlpool of deep blue water ringed by white foam, spiralling into a calm centre that glows aqua. It shows the user's domain of water crushing a foe and the waters flowing back to strengthen the user's healing, matching the jutsu's new description. Drawn in the game's pixel-art icon style; it replaces the old icon as part of the Water's Domain overhaul.
